findings.text: 希望免手动启动并管理本机DSH资料/插件变更的macOS用户，Remote可选；主循环和会话UI归官方Runtime，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
Tauri自带Node/pnpm/Runtime→备份迁移→随机回环Web→WebView/真实Settings桥；恢复与Remote/用量各有独立活动链，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
四材料摘要与固定身份核对；集中macOS Tauri主启动/实际lib launch与Settings client、备份迁移/插件profile安装恢复、LAN代理/compat gateway/有限receipt、用量UI及退出。未执行目标/测试/成品验证；Electron/原生手机UI/所有自动更新、Tailscale ACL、上游Agent Loop和迁移实现未全审，不宣称全项目审计。
应用0.5.0与捆绑DSH0.1.5-rc.2分开；根npm是私有维护包但Rust/Tauri也声明应用0.5.0，不代表所有手机/Host版本统一。固定提交日期不是发布日期。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 正确Tauri成品/Node/pnpm资源 | Mac主路径必需 | 启动官方Web | 不能用旧Electron入口代证Mac |
| 固定DSH与桌面Settings私有模块 | 必需 | 上游Loop/UI/Remote兼容层 | 版本/接口变化需复核 |
| home/.dsh、备份空间/写权限 | 首启/变更需要 | 会话迁移/profile恢复 | 并发变化/备份错误可拒，非OS沙箱 |
| 模型/插件账号和工作区授权 | 真正任务需要 | 上游执行 | 打包不代配置/权限与费用 |
| 可信私网/bearer或Tailscale | Remote可选 | 原生手机控制电脑任务 | 不等多用户隔离/全部TLS |
| 本地session logs/公共价格 | 用量显示 | token/估价 | 无匹配标未知，非provider账单 |

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 包/备份复制/迁移/模型配置未知 | 独立home核版本/旧会话/授权 | 100MB和成品签名未验 |
| 持续使用 | 本机服务/日志/备份/模型/Remote未知 | 依赖、双端协议与功能复核 | 估价不等账单或控费 |
| 失败恢复 | pending/依赖同步/外部副作用未知 | 分迁移/启动/回滚/请求未知对账 | 文件恢复不等全局事务 |
| 退出 | profile/会话/Key/配对/云资料另计 | 真退出/撤Remote配对/资料备份 | 关窗仍运行，关闭不等token轮换 |
独立home和无敏感会话先核启动/迁移/无害故障恢复；Remote另批、核token与任务结果，失败停变更保资料，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 启动便利 | 自带资源/托管/回环Web接线 | 成品体积/各平台成功 |
| 变更恢复 | 快照/pending/回滚再启动 | 会话语义/功能正确/外部效果撤销 |
| 远控任务 | 实际代理到prompt/审批 | 手机全链/跨重启去重与权限隔离 |
| 用量透明 | 未知价格/估价/可见token | 完整账单/经济收益/任务价值 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 备份并发校验/变更journal可借鉴，必须把启动、配置、功能、外部结果分层；[Q03](#research-q03) 配对/receipt和[Q04](#research-q04)未知费用也不能扩大含义。
启动错误恢复、资料备份校验、profile变更记录和回滚、真实受限Remote代理，以及未知费用不记零的显示，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 至 [Q04](#research-q04)。
启动稳定/manifest差异不等功能通过；备份/回滚范围有限，LAN bearer非TLS、回执有限缓存非业务完成，关窗也不等退出，见 [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03) 与 [Q05](#research-q05)。
在既有快照/回滚之上绑定固定Runtime/profile/变更的非破坏功能验收和恢复再验；启动失败时应外部启动器承载，不强作进程内插件，见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 既有Tauri/DSH/桌面壳组合novelty25%超裸转链0%，非新Loop算法不足50%；[Q02](#research-q02)资料备份/变更恢复与[Q03](#research-q03)网关真实接线mechanism75%超启动壳50%，跨版本/功能验证缺口阻100%；外部监督/恢复模式transfer50%超单UI25%，依上游私有适配和格式阻75%；打包免手装并有恢复simplification50%超薄壳25%，模型/迁移/Remote运营阻75%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)启动到[Q02](#research-q02)变更恢复workflow50%超仅单窗口25%，Agent业务Loop借上游且未核接受链阻75%；桌面/双语设置/状态交付delivery50%超文档25%，未验成品/手机阻75%；桌面与可选原生Remote入口reach50%超仅本地网页25%，平台和信任条件阻75%；[Q04](#research-q04)估价展示不改变模型计费或建立预算/资源调度控制，已核贡献未识别economics增量取0%，非未知总费填0。

recommendation.reason: 熟悉 DSH 且能在独立资料目录核对迁移和恢复的 macOS 用户，可先用无敏感会话有限试用本地桌面流程。相比手动启动官方 Web，源码支持自带运行时、备份与插件变更恢复，以及明确标注未知的费用显示，但启动稳定和请求回执并不证明功能或业务结果通过。若历史会话迁移被拒、功能持续异常或回滚未完成，应停止变更和远程访问，保留备份与报告，转安全资料配置或固定官方运行时核查。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 免手启/资料和变更维护具体50%超泛桌面包装25%，缺用户频率/恢复代价样本不足75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 从启动壳进到真实备份/pending/回滚结构增量50%超便利25%，相对其他客户端及语义恢复/功能成效未证不足75%。

evidence.rationale: 真实Tauri/slot→native→launch/官方CLI、代理/gateway和用量callee见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)，源码50%超README25%，未装成品/跑迁移与手机/任务阻75%。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05) 独立home、备份校验、拒pending与明确恢复退路50%超只靠手工未知回退25%，迁移/依赖/Remote与持久资料成本仍重阻75%。

publication.summaries.text: 以 Tauri 托管官方 DSH Web 运行时，加入会话备份迁移、插件变更恢复、费用概览和可选原生手机 Remote 接入。

items.界面: 官方WebView与实际桌面Settings/用量/Remote入口
items.后台: 受管Runtime/Remote子进程与恢复监控
items.事件监听: 会话/桥接事件和profile状态更新

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 桌面托管 | 自启动/显示官方Runtime | 包含资源未独立验成品 |
| 备份/迁移/恢复 | 会话与profile变更 | 有排除/拒绝/部分回滚，不等语义保真 |
| Settings插件管理 | UI→官方CLI→pending | 启动稳定不等功能通过 |
| Remote | 手机发任务/审批/看会话 | 持凭据有实权；LAN HTTP/缓存边界 |
| 用量 | 本地日志+公共价格 | 未知标明，非账单/预算上限 |

publication.advice.text: 独立home和无敏感会话先核启动/迁移/无害故障恢复；Remote另批、核token与任务结果，失败停变更保资料，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "<div align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"build/icon.png\" width=\"96\" height=\"96\" alt=\"DSH Desktop icon\">\n  <h1>DSH Desktop</h1>\n  <p><strong>A compact, self-contained DeepSeek Harness desktop host with native iPhone and Android Remote companions.</strong></p>\n  <p>\n    <a href=\"#download\">Download</a>\n    · <a href=\"#highlights\">Highlights</a>\n    · <a href=\"#iphone-remote-testflight-beta\">iPhone Remote</a>\n    · <a href=\"#android-remote-github-release\">Android Remote</a>\n    · <a href=\"#development\">Development</a>\n    · <a href=\"CONTRIBUTING.md\">Contributing</a>\n  </p>\n  <p>\n    <strong>English</strong>\n    · <a href=\"README.zh-CN.md\">简体中文</a>\n  </p>\n  <p>\n    <a href=\"https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/actions/workflows/ci.yml\"><img src=\"https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg\" alt=\"CI status\"></a>\n    <a href=\"https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop\" alt=\"Latest stable release\"></a>\n    <a href=\"LICENSE\"><img src=\"https://img.shields.io/github/license/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop\" alt=\"MIT License\"></a>\n  </p>\n</div>\n\n![DSH Desktop](docs/images/readme-hero-en.png)\n\n*macOS DMGs around 100 MB, with the complete Harness runtime included.*\n\nDSH Desktop runs the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI and runtime in a desktop window. The repository also contains DSH Remote native companions for continuing the computer's projects, sessions, and running tasks from iPhone and Android. This build is aligned with `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2` and shows that bundled Harness version in the sidebar. The desktop app manages the local Harness process automatically, so users do not need to install Node.js or start `dsh web` themselves.\n\n[Migration and rollback notes](docs/HARNESS_0.1.5_MIGRATION.md)\n\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek AI product. DeepSeek Harness is a developer preview and may introduce breaking changes.\n\n## Highlights\n\n- **Multimodal sessions** — paste or attach images and send them through the normal Harness conversation flow when the selected provider and model declare image input support. Image messages remain visible in session history.\n- **Usage at a glance on macOS** — see today and seven-day token totals, estimated cost, active task count, and aggregate running throughput without leaving the current session.\n- **Compact macOS package** — around 100 MB while bundling the complete Harness runtime, using Tauri and the system WKWebView instead of shipping Chromium.\n- **Visible runtime alignment** — the sidebar identifies both the Desktop release and its bundled Harness version, such as `DSH Desktop v0.5.0 · Harness 0.1.5-rc.2`.\n- **Ready to run** — includes everything needed to start Harness, with no separate Node.js installation or terminal command. The app starts and stops the local runtime automatically.\n- **Native mobile Remote** — the SwiftUI iPhone client and Kotlin/Compose Android client pair on trusted Wi-Fi or the user's own Tailscale network, then browse projects, create sessions, steer tasks, handle approvals, send images, and follow subagents without moving execution off the computer.\n\nCost figures are estimates derived from local token logs and available public model prices. Unmatched models stay visibly unpriced rather than being counted as free.\n\n## Multimodal and usage insights\n\n![Multimodal session and usage insights](docs/images/readme-features-en.png)\n\n*A real Harness rc.8 image-input session with live token and cost insights, using `google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite` through OpenRouter.*\n\nThe compact title-bar summary stays visible while you work. Open it for input, output, cache, cost, and live-throughput details. Usage is calculated locally from Harness session history, with estimated costs based on available public model prices.\n\n## iPhone Remote (TestFlight beta)\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> DSH Remote is available as a public iPhone beta. [Join with TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7Ew6Yk9V).\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/images/remote-home-en.png\" width=\"30%\" alt=\"DSH Remote same-Wi-Fi pairing in English\">\n  <img src=\"docs/images/remote-projects-en.png\" width=\"30%\" alt=\"DSH Remote projects and running sessions in English\">\n  <img src=\"docs/images/remote-conversation-en.png\" width=\"30%\" alt=\"DSH Remote approval handling in English\">\n</p>\n<p align=\"center\"><sub>Same-Wi-Fi pairing · Projects and running sessions · Approval handling</sub></p>\n\nDSH Remote is a native SwiftUI companion for a DSH Desktop computer you own or manage. It does not run an agent, repository, terminal, or model provider on the phone. Work continues on the computer; the iPhone is a narrow control surface.\n\nThe iOS TestFlight beta follows the device's app-language setting and includes complete English and Simplified Chinese product copy, including setup, errors, notifications, approvals, models, Activity, and subagent flows.\n\n- **Same Wi-Fi (recommended):** Desktop exposes an opt-in, authenticated LAN endpoint on a trusted private network. No Tailscale account is required.\n- **Away from the local network:** both devices join the user's own tailnet, and Desktop configures a private Tailscale Serve HTTPS entry. Do not use Funnel.\n- **No project-operated relay:** code, prompts, model credentials, tool execution, and session history remain on the user's computer.\n\n### Install with TestFlight\n\n1. Install Apple's [TestFlight app](https://apps.apple.com/app/testflight/id899247664) on an iPhone running iOS 17 or later.\n2. Open the [DSH Remote public invitation](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7Ew6Yk9V), choose **View in TestFlight**, then accept and install the beta.\n3. Install the current DSH Desktop release on the computer before pairing.\n\n### Build from source with Xcode\n\nDevelopers can also install the source on their own iPhone with Xcode:\n\n1. Install Xcode 16 or later on a Mac and sign in under **Xcode → Settings → Accounts**.\n2. Clone this repository and open `ios/DSHRemote/DSHRemote.xcodeproj`.\n3. Select the `DSHRemote` target, choose your Team under **Signing & Capabilities**, and use a unique bundle identifier if automatic signing requests one.\n4. Connect an iPhone running iOS 17 or later, select it as the run destination, and choose **Product → Run**.\n\nA free Apple Account can use an Xcode Personal Team for personal on-device testing, but the app must be re-provisioned periodically. Downloading an unsigned or unrelated IPA from GitHub will not work.\n\n### Pair and use Remote\n\n1. Install and open the latest DSH Desktop build.\n2. In Desktop, open **Settings → General → Mobile Remote → Connect phone**.\n3. On the same trusted Wi-Fi, start local pairing and scan the QR code in DSH Remote.\n4. For cellular or other remote networks, open the built-in Tailscale setup guide on Desktop or iPhone, enable anywhere access, and scan the HTTPS QR code.\n5. Open a project, create or continue a session, and keep all execution on the computer.\n\nSee the [iOS TestFlight and source guide](ios/DSHRemote/README.md), [Chinese Tailscale setup guide](docs/TAILSCALE_REMOTE_SETUP.zh-CN.md), [privacy policy](docs/PRIVACY.md), [support notes](docs/SUPPORT.md), and [App Review notes](docs/APP_REVIEW_NOTES.md).\n\n## Android Remote (GitHub release)\n\n> [!IMPORTANT]\n> [`v0.4.0`](https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/tag/v0.4.0) is the first stable GitHub release with a signed Android APK. It requires Android 8.0 or later and the matching DSH Desktop build from that release. It is not yet available on Google Play.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/images/android-remote-home-en.png\" width=\"42%\" alt=\"DSH Remote Android onboarding in English\">\n  <img src=\"docs/images/android-remote-conversation-en.png\" width=\"42%\" alt=\"DSH Remote Android approval and conversation controls in English\">\n</p>\n<p align=\"center\"><sub>Local-first pairing and offline Demo · Conversation, queue, and approval control</sub></p>\n\nAndroid uses the same local-first Remote v1 contract, QR format, Desktop LAN proxy, and Tailscale HTTPS flow as iOS. It includes encrypted multi-computer storage, projects and sessions, full conversation and Activity views, queue and steer controls, approvals and structured questions, images and references, models, Goal/Plan, nested subagents, local notifications, offline Demo, English, Simplified Chinese, dark appearance, and TalkBack semantics.\n\nTo install it:\n\n1. Open the [`v0.5.0` release](https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/tag/v0.5.0) and install its Desktop package on the computer.\n2. Download `DSH-Remote-Android-v0.5.0.apk` on an Android 8.0+ device. If asked, temporarily allow **Install unknown apps** for the browser or file manager that opened it.\n3. Compare the APK's SHA-256 with its entry in `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the same release.\n4. Open the offline Demo, or in Desktop choose **Settings → General → Mobile Remote → Connect phone** and scan its QR code.\n\nUse direct same-Wi-Fi mode only on a trusted private network: it is authenticated but not encrypted. Use private Tailscale Serve HTTPS for cellular, remote, or untrusted networks, and never use Funnel. Camera and notification permissions are optional. QR images stay on-device, while the bundled Google ML Kit scanner sends Google the diagnostic and usage metrics described in the [privacy policy](docs/PRIVACY.md#android-qr-scanner-and-google-ml-kit).\n\nThe computer must remain online with Desktop and Harness running. Local notifications are best effort, and device-specific behavior remains documented in the Android guide. See the complete [Android install and support guide](android/README.md), [Simplified Chinese guide](android/README.zh-CN.md), [support guide](docs/SUPPORT.md), and [platform-neutral Remote contract](docs/REMOTE_PROTOCOL_V1.md).\n\n## Download\n\nDownload Desktop installers and the Android APK from the [latest stable GitHub Release](https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest). Installable iOS builds are distributed through the [public TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7Ew6Yk9V).\n\n| Current stable release | Architecture | File |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| macOS | Apple Silicon | `DSH-Desktop-0.5.0-mac-arm64.dmg` |\n| macOS | Intel | `DSH-Desktop-0.5.0-mac-x64.dmg` |\n| Windows 10/11 | x64 installer | `DSH-Desktop-0.5.0-win-x64.exe` |\n| Windows 10/11 | x64 portable | `DSH-Desktop-0.5.0-win-x64.zip` |\n| Android 8.0+ | universal APK | `DSH-Remote-Android-v0.5.0.apk` |\n| iPhone, iOS 17+ | public beta | [TestFlight invitation](https://testflight.apple.com/join/7Ew6Yk9V) |\n\nThe release also includes macOS ZIP archives and `SHA256SUMS.txt` for integrity verification. GitHub does not publish a generic iOS IPA.\n\n## Desktop quick start\n\n1. Install and open DSH Desktop.\n2. Open **Settings → Models** and configure a provider and API key.\n3. Add or select a workspace.\n4. Start a Harness session.\n5. Paste or attach an image when the selected model supports image input.\n\nConfiguration, workspaces, and sessions live in the same `DSH_HOME` used by the official CLI (`~/.dsh` by default).\n\n## Plugins and recovery\n\nOn macOS, open **Settings → Plugins → Install & manage**. The installer accepts an npm package, `github:owner/repo`, a public GitHub HTTPS URL, or a full command such as:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add github:owner/repo\n```\n\nDesktop parses supported install commands without running pasted text through a shell, then checks that Harness restarts successfully. If startup fails, it restores the previous plugin configuration. Third-party plugins run code on the local machine, so review their source and publisher before installation.\n\n## Architecture\n\n```text\n iPhone Remote ── authenticated same-Wi-Fi / Tailnet HTTPS ──┐\nAndroid Remote ── authenticated same-Wi-Fi / Tailnet HTTPS ──┤\n                                                             ↓\nDesktop shell ─────────────→ loopback-only dsh web → official Harness UI/runtime\n       └─────────────────── shared DSH_HOME for settings, sessions, and plugins\n```\n\nThe project does not fork or reimplement the Harness agent runtime. The shell owns desktop packaging, process lifecycle, navigation boundaries, recovery, native integration, and release verification.\n\n## Development\n\nNode.js 22.19 or newer is required.\n\n```bash\ngit clone https://github.com/chokwinlee/deepseek-harness-desktop.git\ncd deepseek-harness-desktop\nnpm ci\nnpm test\nnpm start\n```\n\nBuild the macOS Tauri release with `npm run build:mac`; build the Windows Electron release with `npm run dist`. run \"npm ci\" manually to restore development dependencies' >&2\n}\n\ncleanup() {\n  restore_dev_dependencies\n  find \"$BUILD_TEMP\" -depth -delete 2>/dev/null || true\n}\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\nif [ ! -x \"$CARGO_HOME/bin/cargo\" ]; then\n  case \"$(uname -m)\" in\n    arm64) RUSTUP_HOST=\"aarch64-apple-darwin\" ;;\n    x86_64) RUSTUP_HOST=\"x86_64-apple-darwin\" ;;\n    *) echo \"unsupported build host: $(uname -m)\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n  esac\n  echo \">> bootstrapping Rust toolchain for $RUSTUP_HOST\"\n  curl --fail --silent --show-error \\\n    \"https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/${RUSTUP_HOST}/rustup-init\" \\\n    --output \"$BUILD_TEMP/rustup-init\"\n  chmod +x \"$BUILD_TEMP/rustup-init\"\n  \"$BUILD_TEMP/rustup-init\" -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable --no-modify-path >/dev/null\nfi\nrustup target add \"$TRIPLE\" >/dev/null\n\nif [ ! -x \"$TAURI_CLI\" ]; then\n  echo \">> installing pinned Tauri CLI\"\n  (cd .tauri-cli && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null)\nfi\n\necho \">> installing production dependencies\"\nnpm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund\n\necho \">> pruning runtime for darwin/$NODE_ARCH\"\n(cd node_modules && node \"$REPO_ROOT/scripts/prune-runtime.mjs\" . --platform darwin --arch \"$NODE_ARCH\")\n\nSIDECAR=\"src-tauri/binaries/node-${TRIPLE}\"\nif [ ! -x \"$SIDECAR\" ] || [ \"$(\"$SIDECAR\" --version 2>/dev/null || true)\" != \"v${NODE_VERSION}\" ]; then\n  echo \">> downloading and verifying Node $NODE_VERSION for darwin/$NODE_ARCH\"\n  NODE_ARCHIVE=\"node-v${NODE_VERSION}-darwin-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.gz\"\n  curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \\\n    \"https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/${NODE_ARCHIVE}\" \\\n    --output \"$BUILD_TEMP/$NODE_ARCHIVE\"\n  curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \\\n    \"https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/SHASUMS256.txt\" \\\n    --output \"$BUILD_TEMP/SHASUMS256.txt\"\n  (\n    cd \"$BUILD_TEMP\"\n    grep \" ${NODE_ARCHIVE}$\" SHASUMS256.txt > SHASUMS256.selected\n    shasum -a 256 -c SHASUMS256.selected\n    tar -xzf \"$NODE_ARCHIVE\"\n  )\n  mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries\n  cp \"$BUILD_TEMP/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-darwin-${NODE_ARCH}/bin/node\" \"$SIDECAR\"\n  chmod +x \"$SIDECAR\"\nfi\n\nexport APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY=\"${APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY:--}\"\nif [[ \"$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY\" == \"Developer ID Application:\"* ]]; then\n  : \"${APPLE_ID:?APPLE_ID is required for notarization}\"\n  : \"${APPLE_PASSWORD:?APPLE_PASSWORD is required for notarization}\"\n  : \"${APPLE_TEAM_ID:?APPLE_TEAM_ID is required for notarization}\"\nelse\n  # Tauri enables notarization when these variables merely exist, even if the\n  # GitHub secrets expanded to empty strings. Keep the ad-hoc path truly local.\n  unset APPLE_ID APPLE_PASSWORD APPLE_TEAM_ID\nfi\n\necho \">> signing bundled native dependencies with $APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY\"\nNATIVE_SIGNATURES=0\nwhile IFS= read -r -d '' native_file; do\n  case \"$(file -b \"$native_file\")\" in\n    Mach-O*)\n      if [[ \"$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY\" == \"Developer ID Application:\"* ]]; then\n        codesign --force --timestamp --options runtime \\\n          --sign \"$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY\" \"$native_file\"\n      else\n        codesign --force --options runtime --sign - \"$native_file\"\n      fi\n      NATIVE_SIGNATURES=$((NATIVE_SIGNATURES + 1))\n      ;;\n  esac\ndone < <(find node_modules -type f \\( -name '*.node' -o -name '*.dylib' -o -perm -111 \\) -print0)\necho \"   signed $NATIVE_SIGNATURES native files\"\n\n# Tauri validates every externalBin path from build.rs, including when Cargo is\n# only building the dsh launcher itself. Build the same drag-to-Applications layout with hdiutil only.\nDMG_STAGE=\"$BUILD_TEMP/dmg-root\"\nTAURI_DMG=\"$BUNDLE_ROOT/dmg/DSH-Desktop-${VERSION}-${ARTIFACT_ARCH}.dmg\"\nmkdir -p \"$DMG_STAGE\" \"$BUNDLE_ROOT/dmg\"\nditto \"$APP\" \"$DMG_STAGE/DSH Desktop.app\"\nln -s /Applications \"$DMG_STAGE/Applications\"\nhdiutil create \\\n  -volname \"DSH Desktop\" \\\n  -srcfolder \"$DMG_STAGE\" \\\n  -fs HFS+ \\\n  -format UDZO \\\n  -ov \"$TAURI_DMG\" >/dev/null\nhdiutil imageinfo \"$TAURI_DMG\" >/dev/null\n\necho \">> collecting release artifacts\"\nmkdir -p release\nfind \"release/DSH Desktop.app\" -depth -delete 2>/dev/null || true\ncp -R \"$APP\" \"release/DSH Desktop.app\"\ncp \"$TAURI_DMG\" \"release/DSH-Desktop-${VERSION}-mac-${ARTIFACT_ARCH}.dmg\"\nditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent \\\n  \"release/DSH Desktop.app\" \\\n  \"release/DSH-Desktop-${VERSION}-mac-${ARTIFACT_ARCH}.zip\"\n\necho \"✅ built: release/DSH Desktop.app ($TRIPLE)\"\necho \"   dmg: release/DSH-Desktop-${VERSION}-mac-${ARTIFACT_ARCH}.dmg\"\necho \"   zip: release/DSH-Desktop-${VERSION}-mac-${ARTIFACT_ARCH}.zip\"\n"
